definitions.explanation: A sentence of imprisonment that must actually be served, as opposed to one that is suspended ({執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}). Used in news reports and legal contexts to mark that a defendant will really go to prison.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{実刑|じっけい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}した→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The court handed down an actual prison sentence to the defendant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧がつかず、{実刑|じっけい}になった。
examples.english: There was no suspension, so it became an actual prison sentence.

examples.japanese: {初犯|しょはん}だったが、⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧さから{実刑|じっけい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下|くだ}された。
examples.english: It was a first offense, but given the seriousness of the case, an actual prison sentence was handed down.

notes:
⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (actual) + ⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧ (sentence): a prison term that must genuinely be served, contrasted with a suspended sentence. A staple word in news coverage of criminal trials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {実刑|じっけい}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: an actual-sentence ruling
- {実刑|じっけい}になる: to receive/end up with an actual prison sentence
- {実刑|じっけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}す→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧: to hand down an actual sentence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧: suspended sentence — the opposite outcome; the defendant avoids actually serving time
- ⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧: punishment/sentence in general, without specifying whether it is actually served
